853:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you ignoring me as usual? Still, I've brewed you coffee with my finest beans, $$キリコ$$.」

853:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please give me a little more of a reaction.」

853:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Otherwise, next time I'll be tempted to mix in all sorts of foreign substances to get a reaction.」

853:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... That's a fine reaction, though my life is hanging by a thread...」

853:t_11:4.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「It's strange... These words from a fraud of a robot make me much happier than the Pope's blessing.」

853:t_11:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's because I am a being who surpasses God.」

853:t_11:6.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I can laugh even at such foolish quips because of this freedom I never had in the Church.」

853:t_11:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$フィアナ$$... Your encouragement has allowed me to gain so much...)

853:t_11:8.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I want to offer you and $$キリコ$$ my boundless gratitude...)

853:t_11:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um, hellooo... Have you forgotten I exist...?」

853:t_12:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, those eyes...! That look seems to see right through my armor! Isn't that an invasion of privacy?!」

853:t_12:6.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I never thought I'd hear a word like privacy from you...」

853:t_12:7.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Never mind... I haven't had enough exercise lately, so you'll join me for a workout.」

853:t_12:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, no way! Please put me down gently, $$シャッコ$$, as softly as a feather!」

853:t_12:10.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「That depends on how you act from now on...! Don't betray my trust, $$ＡＧ$$!」

853:t_13:6.en:
$$桂$$
「You remembered to be considerate toward the ladies. You're doing pretty well, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_13:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your praise leaves me deeply grateful, moved and honored, $$桂$$.」

853:t_13:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'd like you to teach me the secret to understanding women, $$桂$$...」

853:t_13:9.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't be so stiff. You won't have any luck wooing girls if you're that uptight.」

853:t_13:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, yeah...? Then, $$桂$$... I'll drop the formalities with you.」

853:t_13:11.en:
$$桂$$
「You're getting awfully familiar all of a sudden!」

853:t_13:12.en:
$$モーム$$
「Hey, $$ＡＧ$$! Don't be so familiar with my dear $$桂$$!」

853:t_13:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, yes. From now on, I'll follow your example and stick to Lord $$桂$$.」

853:t_14:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've heard the tales of your heroic exploits a few times before, $$カミーユ$$, but...」

853:t_14:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This time, I'd like to hear about 'correction'.」

853:t_14:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Correction... Do you mean when military officers use corporal punishment on their subordinates?」

853:t_14:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I'd like to hear a line like, 'I'll correct an adult like you!!'...」

853:t_14:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come on... Do you think any adults in $c deserve that?」

853:t_14:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you sure? Someone clings to the past, uses a false name and keeps whining about cactus flowers...」

853:t_14:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There might be a junk robot here that needs repairs rather than correction.」

853:t_15:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know. It's entirely due to my own shortcomings.」

853:t_15:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, I'll damage this body to atone...」

853:t_15:9.en:
$$ファ$$
「Y-you don't have to go that far...!」

853:t_15:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aww... I thought if I couldn't move, you'd give me round-the-clock care, $$ファ$$.」

853:t_15:11.en:
$$ファ$$
「Don't be so needy! If that happens, I'll ask $$アストナージ$$ to turn you into scrap!」

853:t_15:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The way you treat me... It's a world apart from how you treat $$カミーユ$$...」

853:t_15:13.en:
$$ファ$$
「Huh...? Do you mean $$カミーユ$$ will get hurt...?!」

853:t_15:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I'm only talking about a possibility...」

853:t_16:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Will you treat me to something?」

853:t_16:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For you, $$フォウ$$, I'd even empty $$Ｄトレーダー$$'s safe!」

853:t_16:6.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I'm so happy... I rarely get to be someone's number one like this.」

853:t_16:7.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Even my name says as much. I guess I can't help it...」

853:t_16:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$フォウ$$... If you'd settle for me, I really...」

853:t_16:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then what was all that leading up to?!」

853:t_17:6.en:
$$エマ$$
「That isn't what I mean, but...」

853:t_17:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're kind about young boys' bodily urges, yet you openly discriminate against me because I'm a robot...」

853:t_17:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or are you shutting out the likes of me because you already have a steady partner...?」

853:t_17:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, really... How far has your relationship with Captain $$ヘンケン$$ progressed?」

853:t_17:10.en:
$$エマ$$
「Understand that people are wary of you because you do things like that!」

853:t_18:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「I'm finally an ace pilot too. Maybe I've gotten a little closer to Captain $$アムロ$$ now.」

853:t_18:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you let it go to your head like that...」

853:t_18:6.en:
$$カツ$$
「Don't say I'll crash into a meteorite. You've said that so often that I've started watching out for it too.」
